title: Dixmier unitarisability problem for discrete groups
exact_target: If every uniformly bounded Hilbert-space representation of a discrete group can be made unitary by a change of coordinates, must the group be amenable?

sources.citation: Nicolas Monod and Narutaka Ozawa, The Dixmier problem, lamplighters and Burnside groups, arXiv0902.4585v1 (26Feb2009).
